consulted.section: Disambiguation: Two Similar Objects in Scene
consulted.evidence: There was one intended bottle and one cabinet; the program selected the fixture top by cloud height rather than choosing among similar object masks.
The seed51 prompt probe showed wine bottle scores above 0.92 and black cabinet about 0.46; projected clouds confirmed the intended objects.
Using get_task_context().language resolved the contradictory task name, and both objects were localized before the arm occluded the camera; 15/15 development success.
I treated the cabinet cloud as visible surfaces, extracted its top-plane Z and XY, and computed held-bottle clearance; the selected version passed 15/15 development.
Staged pre-grasp, close, lift, transit, lower and release with guarded motions formed the selected program; all 15 development and 15 unseen seeds succeeded.

The section suggested a side grasp for bottles. On seed51 v01, reorienting to the horizontal side-grasp wrist pose timed out after 159 ticks before contact; the observed downward tool grasp near 80% bottle height worked on v04 and all 15 development seeds.
close_gripper returned contact-aware success in all development runs, and guarded motion results exposed v01/v02 timeouts before false downstream conclusions.
Runtime bottle Z quantiles and fixture top-plane points supplied grasp and release heights; no seed-specific coordinates were encoded.
The section held a placeholder pointer; the task's lift, lateral transit and descent sequence was derived from its own seed51 scene and measured on v04.
The cabinet top was raised and all selected placement motions converged without a pre-probe.
The bottle lifted vertically above the rack; no lateral escape before lift was needed.
The section contained no concrete recipe when consulted; the downward placement target was derived from the held-bottle clearance.
The environment terminated with task success during open_gripper in all development runs, so the guarded fallback settling loop was never entered.
The target was a flat cabinet top, not a basket or container.
This task involved no knob or switch.
The drawer stayed closed; the instruction was to place on its top.
The bottle was picked and carried, not pushed.
The articulated-object notes did not apply to this pick-and-place task.

proposed_edits.change: Describe the downward-neck alternative when a side wrist pose times out: retain the measured initial downward end-effector quaternion and target 80% of the observed bottle Z span with a 0.12 m vertical stand-off. Point to the proposed Downward Bottle Neck Grasp snippet.

proposed_new.title: Downward Bottle Neck Grasp
proposed_new.trigger: Use when an upright wine bottle is visible from agentview, a side wrist rotation is too costly or fails, and the current end-effector points downward. `quantile` is the helper in grasp.md Standard Pick-and-Place Template. The bottle is localized with the literal prompt in the snippet; pre-grasp is 0.12 m above the observed 80%-height neck target. Expect about 57+36+14 ticks for approach, contact and close on seed51; verify object retention after lift.
proposed_new.code:
state = get_robot_state()
frame = state.base_frame
bottle = localize_object("wine bottle", camera_name="agentview", target_frame=frame)
if not bottle.ok or len(bottle.point_cloud.points) < 100:
    raise ValueError("wine bottle not localized")
points = bottle.point_cloud.points
x = quantile((point[0] for point in points), 0.5)
y = quantile((point[1] for point in points), 0.5)
low = quantile((point[2] for point in points), 0.05)
high = quantile((point[2] for point in points), 0.95)
z = low + 0.80 * (high - low)
downward = tuple(state.end_effector_poses["primary"].quaternion_wxyz)
pre = Pose((x, y, z + 0.12), downward, frame)
grasp = Pose((x, y, z), downward, frame)
open_gripper()
if not move_to_pose(pre, tolerance=0.025, max_steps=250).ok:
    raise ValueError("pre-grasp failed")
if not move_to_pose(grasp, tolerance=0.025, max_steps=180).ok:
    raise ValueError("grasp failed")
close_gripper()
proposed_new.evidence: v01 side reorientation timed out after 159 ticks on seed51; v04 downward neck grasp succeeded on seed51 and all development 51–65 (15/15) and unseen 66–80 (15/15).

proposed_new.title: Segmented Fixture Top Placement
proposed_new.trigger: Use after grasping an upright bottle to place on a flat drawer cabinet top. `frame` is get_robot_state().base_frame; `quantile` is the standard grasp.md helper; `gx`, `gy`, `gz` are the measured grasp end-effector position, `bottle_bottom` is the bottle cloud's 5th Z percentile, and `grasp_pose` is the successful grasp pose. The snippet defines its own guarded `move_checked` wrapper and uses the public `Pose` constructor. Start from the 0.12 m vertical pre-grasp stand-off, close, then lift while holding the bottle; its lowest point is `grasp_clearance` below the end-effector. Seed51 lift, lateral transit and descent cost 112, 68 and 49 ticks.
proposed_new.code:
def move_checked(stage, pose, cap):
    answer = move_to_pose(pose, tolerance=0.025, max_steps=cap)
    if not answer.ok:
        raise ValueError(stage + " failed")
cabinet = localize_object("black cabinet", camera_name="agentview", target_frame=frame)
if not cabinet.ok or len(cabinet.point_cloud.points) < 500:
    raise ValueError("cabinet not localized")
cabinet_points = cabinet.point_cloud.points
surface_z = quantile((point[2] for point in cabinet_points), 0.90)
top_points = [point for point in cabinet_points if abs(float(point[2]) - surface_z) < 0.012]
if len(top_points) < 100:
    raise ValueError("cabinet top plane not found")
target_x = quantile((point[0] for point in top_points), 0.5)
target_y = quantile((point[1] for point in top_points), 0.5)
grasp_clearance = gz - bottle_bottom
transit_z = max(gz + 0.30, surface_z + grasp_clearance + 0.15)
move_checked("lift", Pose((gx, gy, transit_z), grasp_pose.quaternion_wxyz, frame), 200)
move_checked("transport", Pose((target_x, target_y, transit_z), grasp_pose.quaternion_wxyz, frame), 260)
release_z = surface_z + grasp_clearance + 0.012
move_checked("lower", Pose((target_x, target_y, release_z), grasp_pose.quaternion_wxyz, frame), 200)
proposed_new.evidence: The complete frozen v04 sequence placed the bottle on the cabinet in development 51–65 (15/15) and exact-once unseen 66–80 (15/15); no isolated top-plane ablation was performed.
